field_updates.detail: 'Forward Current vs. Forward Voltage', HIGH EFFICIENCY RED, 'Ta = 25 C' (linear 0-20 mA vs 1.3-2.3 V); frame x 55.262->1.3 V, 151.32->2.3 V; y 367.859->0 mA, 278.52->20 mA. Curve read from the PDF vector polyline vertices (pdftocairo -svg), axes calibrated from the plot frame/gridlines; vertices with I >= 0.8 mA used. Least-squares fit of V = N*Vt*ln(I/IS) + I*RS, Vt = 0.025693 V (25 C). 14 points, rms 6.3 mV. Window 1.07-20 mA; the last point is where the trace leaves the 20 mA top of the frame (2.001 V). Excluding it gives N 3.57, RS 5.78 (rms 6.0 mV). Cross-check: model VF(10 mA)=1.896 V (ngspice) vs table typ 1.9 V; below 2.3 V max. IS, N and RS are correlated and must be used together as one set. Runtime uses .options tnom=25 / .temp 25 (netlist.py).
field_updates.scope: Kingbright WP113IDT high efficiency red; OHMNI simulation-model fit to the datasheet's own typical 25 C forward curve; not a guaranteed limit

remaining_open_items: RthJA and maximum junction temperature are not tabulated; do not borrow the 5 mm lamp thermal model.
Typical I-V/optical transfer and failure timing are not fully fitted.

Former simulation blocker resolved for the bound reference Kingbright WP113IDT (2026-10-11, D070): The copied thermal parameters are unsourced for this rectangular lamp. Resolution: Kingbright's current 2 x 5 mm rectangular lamp WP113IDT (DSAF1525 V.10A, 2025) tabulates Tj 125 C, RthJA 580 C/W and RthJS 350 C/W (FR4, pad >= 16 mm2 per pad) with PD/IF/IFP/VR and a 25 C forward curve. The binding moves from W113HDT (no thermal data) to WP113IDT; the borrowed 5 mm thermal model is not used.
Forward-current derating versus ambient is not encoded.
Bicolor or stackable bar variants are not bound.
